steps.title: Give notice at the old rental and plan the move-out inspection
documents: Written notice to end the tenancy
prepare: Check the tenancy agreement: month-to-month or fixed term
Written notice, delivered so the landlord gets it in time
Forwarding address in writing for the deposit
steps.howTo:
1. On a month-to-month tenancy, the landlord receives the tenant's written notice at least one full rental month before it takes effect, not just 30 days.
2. The landlord offers times for a move-out condition inspection; a tenant who skips it can lose the right to the damage or pet deposit back.
3. After getting the forwarding address in writing, the landlord has 15 days to return the deposits with interest or apply to keep them; if not, the tenant can ask the Residential Tenancy Branch for double.
conditions: Only if you rented the old home in B.C.

steps.title: Sign the tenancy agreement or complete the purchase
prepare: View the unit in person or by live video before paying anything
Check the landlord owns or manages the unit
Note the move-in date, rent, what is included and the deposit amounts
steps.howTo:
1. Landlords in B.C. prepare a written tenancy agreement for every tenancy; the Residential Tenancy Branch has a standard form.
2. The security deposit is at most half of one month's rent, charged at the start of the tenancy; a pet damage deposit has the same limit.
3. A landlord keeps a deposit only with the tenant's written agreement or an order from the Residential Tenancy Branch.
4. For a purchase, the lawyer or notary handles the transfer; the timing here is an estimate.

steps.title: Register the children at the new catchment school
prepare: Find the catchment school for the new address on the school district website
Child's birth certificate or other proof of age
Proof of B.C. residency, if new to B.C.
steps.howTo:
1. B.C. school districts assign schools by catchment area, based on the home address.
2. Registration is done with the school or the district office; each district sets its own list of papers.
3. A place at a school outside the catchment depends on space; ask the district.
conditions: Only if you have school-age children

steps.title: Order mail forwarding from Canada Post
prepare: Canada Post account, if ordering online
steps.howTo:
1. For a move, forwarding comes in 4-month and 12-month terms, with a fee.
2. Ordered online, it starts 5 days after purchase; at a post office, 3 days after.
3. Forwarding gives time to update the bank, employer, insurers and subscriptions.

steps.title: Set up electricity, gas and internet
prepare: Check which utilities the lease includes
BC Hydro for electricity in most of B.C.
FortisBC for natural gas, and for electricity in parts of the southern interior
Close or move the accounts at the old home
steps.howTo:
1. Start dates are set online or by phone with each provider.
2. Internet installs can take a week or more to book.
3. A final meter reading at the old home closes that account.

steps.title: Start tenant or home insurance at the new address
prepare: Check whether the lease asks for tenant insurance
steps.howTo:
1. Tenant insurance covers belongings and liability; the building's own policy usually does not.
2. The tenancy law does not set it, but a tenancy agreement can ask for it.
3. Moving an existing policy is usually a call to the insurer.

steps.title: Do the move-in condition inspection with the landlord
prepare: Photos of every room with dates
A copy of the RTB-27 form or the landlord's own
steps.howTo:
1. The landlord books the inspection and offers at least 2 times for it.
2. Landlord and tenant walk through together and sign the report; the landlord gives the tenant a copy within 7 days.
3. A landlord who skips the inspection loses the right to claim against the security or pet deposit for damage.
conditions: Only if you rent

steps.title: Update the address on the licence, BC Services Card and vehicle at ICBC
prepare: Driver's licence or BC Services Card number
Vehicle registration, if you own a car
steps.howTo:
1. ICBC asks drivers to report a new home address within 10 days of moving.
2. Address Change BC updates the BC Services Card and the B.C. driver's licence online, and can notify several other B.C. government services at once; the service lists which ones.
3. A photo card gets an address sticker by mail.
4. The vehicle registration and insurance address is updated too, at an Autoplan broker or ICBC; the premium can change with the new area.
conditions: Only if you moved within B.C.

steps.title: Apply for MSP and keep the old province's coverage for the wait
documents: Health card from the old province
prepare: Note the date coverage will start
Tell the old province's health plan the moving date
steps.howTo:
1. New B.C. residents wait the rest of the arrival month plus 2 months before MSP coverage starts.
2. The province says to keep coverage from the former province's plan during the wait.
3. Each family member's wait starts on the day they arrive in B.C.
4. Enrolment gives a Personal Health Number, used for the BC Services Card and the Health Connect Registry.
conditions: Only if you moved to B.C. from another province

steps.title: Change the address with the Canada Revenue Agency
steps.howTo:
1. A change in CRA My Account takes effect right away; by phone it is also immediate, by mail 4 to 6 weeks.
2. The CRA does not pass the new address to other departments, so each one is told separately.
3. Benefit payments depend on current details, so updating before tax season avoids gaps.
4. The province lived in on December 31 is the one used for that year's provincial tax.

steps.title: Update the voter registration with Elections BC and Elections Canada
prepare: Ticking the Elections Canada box on the tax return also shares the address with them
steps.howTo:
1. Elections BC and Elections Canada keep separate lists; each has an online registration service.
2. Being registered at the current address avoids extra steps at the polls.
conditions: Only if you are a Canadian citizen

steps.title: Register and insure the vehicle in B.C.
prepare: Proof of driving experience, such as a driver's abstract
Ask ICBC or an Autoplan broker whether an inspection is needed first
steps.howTo:
1. ICBC gives new residents 30 days after arriving to register, license and insure a vehicle; commercial vehicles are immediate.
2. Proof of insurance from the old province is no longer asked for, but driving experience is.
3. Vehicles from outside B.C. may need an inspection before registration; ICBC or the broker confirms.
conditions: Only if you moved to B.C. from another province
Only if you own a vehicle

steps.title: Join the Health Connect Registry for a family doctor
steps.howTo:
1. The registry is how B.C. matches people with a family doctor or nurse practitioner.
2. Registering online takes a few minutes, or call 8-1-1.
3. People already on the registry update the address, since matching is by community.
4. The local team makes contact when a provider becomes available; waits vary.

steps.title: Get a card at the local library
prepare: Proof of the new address, such as a utility bill or the lease
steps.howTo:
1. Public library cards are free for residents of the library's area.
2. Cards from the old area often still work, but the home library changes with the address.

steps.title: Exchange the driver's licence at ICBC
prepare: Book an appointment at a driver licensing office
steps.howTo:
1. New residents have 90 days to switch to a B.C. licence and can drive on the valid old one meanwhile.
2. An original driver's abstract lets ICBC recognize up to 15 years of driving experience.
3. The old licence is surrendered; B.C. allows one licence per person.
4. The licence and BC Services Card can be combined at the same visit.
conditions: Only if you moved to B.C. from another province
Only if you drive

steps.title: Get the BC Services Card
prepare: Combine it with the licence exchange if possible
steps.howTo:
1. After enrolling in MSP, the photo card is made at an ICBC driver licensing office.
2. The card itself has no fee.
3. It shows the Personal Health Number and can be set up in the BC Services Card app for online government services.
conditions: Only if you moved to B.C. from another province

steps.title: Claim the B.C. renter's tax credit on next year's return
prepare: Addresses and landlord details for each rental in the year
Total rent paid and months rented
steps.howTo:
1. The credit is up to $400 a year for low- and moderate-income renters; it phases out above an income threshold that changes each year.
2. It counts renters who lived in eligible B.C. rental units for at least 6 one-month periods in the year and were B.C. residents on December 31; rent at the old and new B.C. addresses both count.
3. It is claimed on form BC479 with the return, due April 30; move this step to that date. It repeats each year.
conditions: Only if you rent
Only if you live in B.C. on December 31

title: Moving home · China
summary: Paperwork plan for moving to a new home in a mainland Chinese city, within the same province or from another one: lease, residence registration and permit, hukou, social insurance, provident fund, school and driving. National rules; local offices set the details.
conditions: For a Chinese citizen moving to a new home in a mainland Chinese city, from the same province or another one
Some steps apply only to people whose hukou (户口) stays elsewhere, renters, employees, drivers or families with children
The moving day is the anchor date; cities publish their own lists and deadlines

sources.title: Social Insurance Law of the PRC — State Taxation Administration law library
National Social Insurance Public Service Platform (国家社会保险公共服务平台)
National Healthcare Security Administration
State Council decision amending the Housing Provident Fund Regulations (住房公积金管理条例, State Council Order No. 844, effective September 20, 2026; check current) — gov.cn
Housing Provident Fund Regulations, consolidated text — Ministry of Justice regulations database
Motor Vehicle Driving Licence Application and Use Provisions (MPS Order 162) — gov.cn
Traffic Safety Integrated Service Platform (交管12123) — Ministry of Public Security
市教委关于2026年上海市义务教育阶段学校招生入学工作的实施意见 (Shanghai enrollment 2026) — Shanghai Municipal Government (example)
Interim Measures for Individual Income Tax Special Additional Deductions (国发〔2018〕41号) — State Taxation Administration

steps.title: Sign the rental contract (租赁合同) or complete the purchase
prepare: See the landlord's property certificate (房产证 or 不动产权证书) and ID
If renting through an agent, check the agent's business licence
Note the rent, deposit (押金), payment cycle and who pays utilities and property fees
steps.howTo:
1. The contract is signed with the owner or someone the owner has authorized in writing.
2. A contract that can be registered (备案) later, and landlord papers that match it, are what the residence registration, residence permit and school steps usually ask for.
3. For a purchase, the property certificate in your name plays the same role.

steps.title: Transfer the water, electricity and gas accounts (水电燃气过户)
prepare: Account numbers from the landlord or seller
Pay any arrears before the handover
steps.howTo:
1. Electricity is usually handled through the State Grid app (网上国网) or the local grid company; water and gas through the city's providers.
2. For a rental, the accounts often stay in the owner's name; the meter readings on handover day settle who pays what.
3. Broadband is set up with the operator; the building may limit which ones.

steps.title: Register the new address with the local police (居住登记)
documents: Residence registration certificate (居住登记凭证)
prepare: Proof of work or study, if the city asks
steps.howTo:
1. People living away from their hukou (户口) address register where they live at the local police station (派出所) or a community service point; many cities also take it online.
2. The deadline and paperwork are set by each city; the week here is an estimate.
3. The registration date is often what starts the 6-month count toward a residence permit.
4. Some landlords or hotels register tenants themselves; ask whether that has been done.
conditions: Only if your hukou (户口) is not in the new city

steps.title: Register the rental contract (租赁合同备案)
documents: Rental contract registration certificate (租赁备案证明)
steps.howTo:
1. Rental contracts are registered (备案) with the local housing authority (住房和城乡建设部门), often online through the city's rental platform (网签备案).
2. Landlords or agents usually file it; tenants can often file too.
3. The registration certificate is often asked for by the residence permit, provident fund rent withdrawal and school applications.
4. The deadline is set locally; the timing here is an estimate.
conditions: Only if you rent

steps.title: Update the address with the traffic police (交管12123)
prepare: Vehicle plate number, if you own a car
steps.howTo:
1. Under MPS Order 162, a driver whose phone number or address changes files it (备案) with the vehicle management office that issued the licence within 30 days.
2. The 交管12123 app handles this online.
3. A driver whose hukou moves out of the issuing area applies for a new licence (换证) at the new area's office; one living outside it can apply to the local office.
4. A car's registration details are updated through the same app.
conditions: Only if you drive or own a vehicle

steps.title: Update the address with banks, the phone operator and the tax app
prepare: Individual income tax app (个人所得税)
steps.howTo:
1. Banks keep a current address for account records; most update it in their app.
2. The phone number itself moves with you, but some operators handle bills or broadband by city.
3. In the individual income tax app, the address and the employer (任职受雇信息) are updated so deductions such as rent go to the right place.

steps.title: Transfer the pension insurance record (养老保险关系转移接续)
prepare: Check the new employer has enrolled you in the new city
National Social Insurance Public Service Platform (国家社会保险公共服务平台) or the 掌上12333 app
steps.howTo:
1. Under the Social Insurance Law, basic pension insurance follows the worker across regions and years paid are added together.
2. After the new city's account is opened, the transfer is requested online through the national platform or the 掌上12333 app, or at the new city's social insurance office.
3. The offices exchange the record between themselves; the 45 days is an estimate.
4. Within the same province, many areas handle transfers inside one provincial system.
conditions: Only if you work in the new city and paid social insurance (社保) in another city

steps.title: Transfer the medical insurance (医保关系转移接续)
prepare: National medical insurance app (国家医保服务平台)
Social security card or ID card
Or a cross-region medical treatment filing (异地就医备案), if staying on the old city's plan
steps.howTo:
1. Basic medical insurance can be transferred between cities; the request is made online through the national medical insurance app or at the local medical insurance office.
2. Years paid carry over; some cities add a short wait before new benefits start, so ask about any gap.
3. For anyone keeping the old city's plan for a while, a cross-region treatment filing (异地就医备案) lets hospital bills in the new city settle directly.
conditions: Only if you had medical insurance (医保) in another city

steps.title: Transfer the housing provident fund (住房公积金转移接续)
prepare: Check the new employer has opened a fund account
Old fund centre and account number
The national housing provident fund mini-program, or the new city's fund centre
steps.howTo:
1. Under the Housing Provident Fund Regulations, an employee who changes employer has the account transferred.
2. Between cities, the transfer is requested at the new city's fund centre or online through the national service, and the balance moves over.
3. Some cities count months paid elsewhere toward their loan rules; ask the new centre.
4. The 30 days is an estimate.
conditions: Only if you work in the new city and paid into a housing provident fund in another city

steps.title: Check the school enrolment rules for the new address
documents: Residence permit (居住证) or property certificate (房产证)
prepare: The district education bureau's enrolment notice (招生入学实施意见)
Months of social insurance paid in this city
steps.howTo:
1. Children with a local hukou usually enrol by the household register and home address; children without one (随迁子女) usually by a residence permit, plus proof of work and home.
2. Shanghai (example, 2026): the child holds a Shanghai residence permit or residence registration, and one parent a residence permit with 6 months of city social insurance within a year.
3. Applications open once a year, usually in spring; check the dates early, since the residence permit takes half a year.
4. The School years · primary · China plan has the enrolment steps.
conditions: Only if you have children of kindergarten or school age

steps.title: Apply for the residence permit (居住证)
prepare: Proof of home: registered rental contract or property certificate
Proof of a stable job, business or studies, such as a labour contract or social insurance record
steps.howTo:
1. A residence permit generally follows at least half a year of living in the city with a stable job, home or studies.
2. It is applied for at the local police station or a service point the police appoint; many cities take it online.
3. Holders get local public services such as compulsory education for children, employment services and some exit-entry and driving services.
4. The permit is endorsed (签注) each year to stay valid.
conditions: Only if your hukou (户口) is not in the new city

steps.title: Check whether the hukou can move (户口迁移)
prepare: The new city's settlement (落户) conditions: home ownership, job and social insurance years, education or points
Property certificate, labour contract or social insurance record
Check what else changes with the hukou, such as school places and pension collection
steps.howTo:
1. Most smaller cities have eased or removed limits on moving a hukou in; large cities use conditions such as years of social insurance or points (积分落户).
2. Moving within the same city, a hukou can often follow a home the family owns.
3. Many cities now handle the move-out and move-in in one place (跨省通办); ask the new police station.
4. The ID card address follows the hukou, so a new ID card is applied for after the move.
5. The timing here is an estimate.
conditions: Only if you want to move your hukou (户口) and meet the new city's conditions

steps.title: Keep social insurance contributions unbroken (避免社保断缴)
prepare: Last month paid in the old city
First month the new employer or you will pay
steps.howTo:
1. Many city rules count continuous months of local social insurance: home purchase eligibility, hukou points (积分落户) and school places for children without a local hukou.
2. A gap between the old and new city can reset that count, and a medical insurance gap can bring a waiting period.
3. Between jobs, some people pay as a flexible worker (灵活就业) to avoid a gap; check the local rule.
4. The count is set city by city; check the new city's rule.

steps.title: Transfer the children's school and student status (转学 / 学籍转接)
conditions: Only if you have school-age children who change school
steps.howTo:
1. After the new school accepts the child, the transfer is made in the national student status system (全国中小学生学籍信息管理系统); the old school confirms it.
2. Transfers are usually handled at the start of a term; ask both schools early.
3. The school place itself follows the new city's enrolment rules; see the school step.

steps.title: Claim the housing rent deduction (住房租金专项附加扣除)
conditions: Only if you rent
Only if you or your spouse own no home in the city where you work and do not claim the mortgage interest deduction
prepare: Landlord's name and ID or company details
steps.howTo:
1. Rent in the city of work can be deducted each month: 1,500 yuan in municipalities, provincial capitals and other listed cities; 1,100 yuan in other cities with a registered population over 1 million; 800 yuan elsewhere.
2. A married couple working in the same city: only one of them claims it.
3. It cannot be combined with the housing loan interest deduction.
4. Declare it in the 个人所得税 app; it is confirmed again each December.

steps.title: Arrange medical insurance for family members without a job
conditions: Only if parents or family members without a job move with you
documents: Medical insurance enrolment or cross-region medical care filing
prepare: Their resident ID cards and hukou
Residence permit, if they have one
steps.howTo:
1. They can keep resident medical insurance (城乡居民医保) where their hukou is and file for cross-region medical care (异地就医备案) in the national medical insurance app, so costs in the new city are settled directly.
2. Many cities also let people with a residence permit join the local resident insurance.
3. Resident insurance is paid yearly, usually in a window near the year end; check the local dates.

steps.title: Withdraw the housing provident fund for rent (租房提取公积金)
conditions: Only if you rent
Only if you pay into a housing provident fund and own no home in the city
steps.howTo:
1. The regulations list paying rent as a ground for withdrawal; the amount and how often are set by each fund centre, often monthly or quarterly up to a cap.
2. Many centres accept it online without a contract if you own no home in the city.
3. Fund centres decide within 3 days of accepting the application under the regulations as amended from September 20, 2026 (check current).

steps.title: Transfer the car's registration to the new city (转籍)
conditions: Only if you own a car registered in another city
prepare: Vehicle registration certificate (机动车登记证书)
Residence permit or hukou in the new city
steps.howTo:
1. A car registered elsewhere can be moved to the new city's plates (转籍 / 迁入) at the vehicle office; many cities handle it without going back to the old city.
2. Big cities with plate quotas may limit or bar moving plates in, and restrict out-of-town plates on some roads or days.
3. Emission standards for moving a car in are set locally; check before moving.

steps.title: Renew the residence permit each year (居住证签注)
conditions: Only if your hukou (户口) is not in the new city
prepare: Proof you still live, work or study in the city
steps.howTo:
1. The residence permit is endorsed (签注) once a year to stay valid; many cities do it online or at self-service machines.
2. A lapsed permit can break the count of years that school places or hukou points rely on.
3. It repeats every year; the date here assumes the permit was issued at about 6 months.

title: Moving home · Ontario
summary: Paperwork plan for moving to a new home in an Ontario city, from within Ontario or from another province: lease, mail, utilities, ServiceOntario, OHIP, voting, tax and settling in.
conditions: You are moving to a new home in an Ontario city, from elsewhere in Ontario or from another province
Some steps apply only to people new to Ontario, drivers, renters or families with children
The moving day is the anchor date; steps before it are counted back from it

sources.title: Change your address on your driver's licence, vehicle permit and health card — Ontario.ca
Apply for OHIP and get a health card — Ontario.ca
Exchange an out-of-province driver's licence — Ontario.ca
Renting in Ontario: your rights — Ontario.ca
Guide to Ontario's standard lease — Ontario.ca
A Guide to the Residential Tenancies Act — Landlord and Tenant Board
Landlord and Tenant Board — Tribunals Ontario
Find a family doctor or nurse practitioner — Ontario.ca

Ontario Trillium Benefit — Ontario.ca
Change your address — Canada Revenue Agency
